meta.title: Become a Sponsor
meta.description: Partner with Khalifa University Formula Student. Sponsorship tiers, deliverables, in-kind options and how to start a conversation.

header.title: Be on the first car this university has ever built
header.body: {longName} is building {university}'s first Formula Student car — a {architecture} single-seater for {competition} {year} at {venue}. There is exactly one season in which a company can be a founding partner of this programme, and this is it.

process.heading: What happens when you get in touch

steps.title: We reply within two working days
steps.body: From a person on the partnerships team, not an autoresponder.

steps.title: You get a written proposal
steps.body: Which tier fits, what your logo goes on, and what we will report back at the end of the season.

steps.title: We agree it before you commit
steps.body: Nothing is invoiced until the deliverables are written down and you have signed them off, subject to university approval.

process.inKindNote: In-kind support — parts, machining, materials, software — is worth as much to us as cash. Ask either way.

reasons.title: What a partnership actually buys
reasons.lead: Four things, and we would rather be specific about them than promise exposure. We have no results to trade on yet — so this is what we can actually offer.
reasons.tbcTooltip: To be confirmed with the team

tiers.title: Sponsorship tiers
tiers.lead: Every tier is compared on the same eight things, so you can read across a row rather than hunt for what was left out. Not sure which fits? Tell us what you had in mind and we will advise.
tiers.inKindFootnote: Benefits and recognition will be agreed according to the value, relevance and impact of the contribution, subject to university approval.
tiers.liveryFootnote: Vehicle and logo placement is illustrative and subject to final livery design, university approval and competition regulations.
tiers.currencyFootnote: Amounts are in UAE dirhams. Dollar equivalents are indicative only, at a fixed reference rate — the dirham is pegged, but these are not quoted prices.

inKind.title: You do not have to write us a cheque
inKind.lead: A large share of Formula Student sponsorship is parts, not cash — and it is often worth more to us than the equivalent money, because it comes with expertise attached.
inKind.body: We value in-kind contributions at market rate and place you at the equivalent tier, with the same benefits. If you are not sure whether what you do is useful to us, ask — the answer is usually yes.

categories.title: Materials and vehicle components
categories.body: Steel, fasteners, composites, cells, motors, inverters — anything that ends up bolted to the car.

categories.title: Manufacturing and machining services
categories.body: Welding, five-axis work, waterjet, sheet metal. Turnaround matters as much as capacity.

categories.title: Software and engineering tools
categories.body: CAD, CFD, FEA, lap simulation, data acquisition and PCB tooling licences.

categories.title: Equipment and testing support
categories.body: Dyno time, rig time, measurement equipment, or somewhere safe to run the car.

categories.title: Transportation and logistics
categories.body: Freight from Abu Dhabi to Silverstone and back — one of our largest fixed costs.

categories.title: Technical consultation and expertise
categories.body: Design review attendance, mentoring, or a day of an engineer's time. Often worth more than the equivalent cash.

enquiry.title: Start the conversation
enquiry.lead: Tell us roughly what you have in mind and we will come back with a concrete proposal, usually within two working days.
enquiry.prospectusUnavailable: The written prospectus is being finalised for this season. Ask us for it and we will send it the moment it is ready — usually the same week.
enquiry.formNote: All fields are required except the tier, which we are happy to advise on.
enquiry.messagePlaceholder: What you are interested in, and anything you would want from a partnership.
enquiry.prospectusAvailable: The full pack: tiers, deliverables, reach figures and last season's report.
